Facts used:
- Harrowfield’s 2025 budget was 16,021.7 million tenge, and it had 13,904 pupils. [NR-07]
- Tarnvale’s 2025 budget was 12,960.3 million tenge, and it had 10,652 pupils. [NR-03]
- 1 million tenge = 1,000 thousand tenge.

Calculations:
- Harrowfield: \(16,021.7 \times 1,000 \div 13,904 = 1,152.107...\) thousand tenge per pupil.
- Tarnvale: \(12,960.3 \times 1,000 \div 10,652 = 1,216.063...\) thousand tenge per pupil.
- Difference: \(1,216.063... - 1,152.107... = 63.956...\) thousand tenge per pupil.

ANSWER: Tarnvale | 63.956
